incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: Incident PDR-4021 fired for eu-central / AZ11 — high 5xx error rate observed on inference-proxy pool (agent: model-proxy-az11). Auto-notify to on-call.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert -> PDR-4021: High error rate (5xx) on /v1/generate in eu-central AZ11. Priority: P2. Primary on-call: Priya K.

Priya K: acked and on my way. looking at dashboards now.

Omar R: i'm joining the call. loading recent qps/errors. quick note: autoscaler looks normal but there's a spike in connection resets to shard-manager from proxies.

Chen Gao: i see the same in logs — repeated TLS handshake timeouts and shard sync failures. probable control-plane connectivity blip for that AZ. grabbing logs from proxy nodes.

Priya K: paste of proxy stderr (tail):
```
[2026-03-15T03:12:03Z] ERR proxy: upstream connect error: connection reset by peer (shard-manager-11)
[2026-03-15T03:12:04Z] WARN cache: kv cache miss rate spike -> 92%
[2026-03-15T03:12:05Z] ERR http: 502 from model-host-az11-07
```

Lina Morales: can we confirm customer impact? metrics show ~18% requests from eu-central saw >500ms or 5xx in the last 10m. adding that to incident notes.

Priya K: agree. action plan: 1) try quick restart of shard-manager-replicas in AZ11 (rolling, 1 at a time), 2) if not stabilized in 8 minutes, trigger traffic diversion to eu-central-az10 fallback pool, 3) notify sales/support for affected customers.

Omar R: starting rolling restart on shard-manager-az11-01 -> command: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart statefulset/shard-manager-az11 -l replica=1`

infra-bot: execution started for restart job shard-manager-az11 (job id jb-8821). will report status.

oncall-sre: note — avoid scaling down proxies while restarts are in flight, they'll fail healthchecks and cause flapping.

Chen Gao: restart didn't fully clear errors; seeing persistent handshake failures and a subset of hosts failing healthchecks. it's been ~7m since alert.

Priya K: initiating fallback routing now. Lina can you run route-divert?

Lina Morales: running diversion:
```
# divert 80% of AZ11 inference traffic to AZ10 fallback pool
routediverter --region eu-central --from az11 --to az10 --percent 80 --reason "shard-manager connectivity" --ticket INC-2026
```

infra-bot: routediverter: diversion job started (id rd-774). preview: az11 -> az10 80% (gradual over 30s).

incident-bot: Automated fallback activation complete: 80% traffic diverted from eu-central AZ11 -> eu-central AZ10. No config rollback scheduled.

pagerduty-bot: PDR-4021 escalated to SRE Lead (L2) after 8m without full recovery.

Omar R: post-diversion metrics: 5xx rate in region dropped from 18% -> 3.2% within 90s. latency median improved ~120ms. still see ~2% residual 5xx from remaining AZ11 traffic.

Priya K: good. Customer impact summary for status post: ~15% of region traffic impacted at peak, now reduced to ~2-3% due to fallback. Estimated affected customers: 6 mid-market tenants with sustained errors during peak window (support notified).

Chen Gao: creating incident ticket and runbook stub: INC-2026. Adding logs, restart steps attempted, routediverter run id rd-774, and affected host list.

Lina Morales: handing off active incident lead to me — Priya, thanks. i'll continue remediation and postmortem. next on-call check-in at 04:00 UTC.

Priya K: handing off — i'm clear to sign off operationally. follow-up actions for postmortem: 1) deep-dive on control-plane network fabric in AZ11, 2) add probe for shard-manager TLS handshake latency, 3) make diversion playbook explicit for autoscaling + routing interactions.

infra-bot: diversion job rd-774 complete. rollback CLI available: `routediverter --rollback rd-774` if needed.

pagerduty-bot: PDR-4021 acknowledged by Priya K, escalated, and status set to "Mitigated" pending postmortem.

Chen Gao: logging final note — saved diagnostic bundle to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/INC-2026/diagnostics.tgz

Lina Morales: i'll keep this thread updated with timeline and postmortem link. thanks team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident thread closed for active paging (status: monitored). Automated reminders will check for postmortem completion in 72h."
